Both `useMemos` and `useInfiniteMemos` call ListMemos.

`useInfiniteMemos` is the active frontend hook in PagedMemoList. The six requested roles must be mapped to exact file paths.

The frontend hook is `useInfiniteMemos` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. The client file is `web/src/connect.ts`. The proto RPC is `ListMemos` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`.

The backend handler is `APIV1Service.ListMemos` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The store method is `Store.ListMemos` in `store/memo.go`. The dialect implementation is `DB.ListMemos` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`.

q12.
frontend hook (useInfiniteMemos) — web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
client file — web/src/connect.ts
proto RPC (ListMemos) — proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
backend handler file — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
store method file — store/memo.go
dialect implementation file — store/db/sqlite/memo.go

**Path summary:** `useInfiniteMemos` (also `useMemos` in the same file) calls `memoServiceClient.listMemos` in `web/src/connect.ts`, which hits the `ListMemos` RPC defined in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The backend handler `APIV1Service.ListMemos` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `Store.ListMemos` in `store/memo.go`, which delegates to the dialect-specific `DB.ListMemos` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (Postgres and MySQL equivalents exist at `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`).
